lines.text: Cursed be the hearts that fear
The dark delights that linger near
In death's cold arms, where shadows bleed
I thrive on hunger, on wicked need
I dared defy the veil and grave
To make you mine, my dark enclave
A lover's soul, no longer pure
Bound to me in a fate obscure
They call it sin, they call it wrong
Yet here with you, I grow more strong
A spell-bound force, I hold, I claim
I live to taste this haunted flame
Necromantical, this grip so tight
A kiss that steals all breath and light
You'll dance with me, forever bound
A prisoner to the dead and drowned
I traced your steps in ash and dust
Through crypts of sorrow, grief, and rust
With twisted love, I broke your chains
Now flesh and shadow wear my reins
You begged release; I swore you'd stay
No peace for those I steal away
Your heartbeat slows, your spirit fades
A puppet now in death's charade
Necromantical, you're mine to keep
Entangled deep in shadows steep
I drink your cries, each lifeless sigh
A tragic love that will not die
To love is sweet, to own divine
In shadows deep, your soul is mine
I wield your will, I bend your breath
A captive heart, enslaved in death
They call me vile, a villain's creed
But love demands the darkest deed
I took your life, yet set you free
In chains of night, you're bound to me
Necromantical, my cursed refrain
Through death's embrace, my cruel domain
In life you fled, in death you stay
Forever locked in my decay
So whisper low, confess your fear
In death's embrace, you're chained right here
They'll say it's wrong, a tale profaned
But darling, we are death's ordained
Necromantical, in shadow's vice
This love of dark, the final price
I wear your soul, a triumph cold
The lifeless heart, in death's firm hold
